name: Perőcsény (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Perőcsény: a blue and green shield with a church, a crescent, a figure and a plant, above a scroll inscribed PERŐCSÉNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
